The owner is frustrated. They clicked the reset link I provided and it drove them to ivxholding.com (the homepage), NOT to a reset password page. Let me watch the video to understand what happened, and look at the actual flow.

The link I gave was:
https://kvclcdjmjghndxsngfzb.supabase.co/auth/v1/verify?token=906ce281aa5d58d272f6ea2ea544b0f2088d26993d518cb91088ee2b&type=recovery&redirect_to=https%3A%2F%2Fivxholding.com%2Freset-password

When clicked in a browser (Chrome on mobile per the video), Supabase's /auth/v1/verify endpoint exchanges the token and then redirects to the `redirect_to` URL. But there's a critical issue: the `redirect_to` URL must be in Supabase's allowed redirect URLs list (`uri_allow_list`). I patched `uri_allow_list` to include `https://ivxholding.com/reset-password`, but Supabase may have a separate behavior.

Wait - actually looking back at the response from generate_owner_password_reset_link:
- `uri_allow_list` is `"https://ivxholding.com/reset-password"` (confirmed in getResponse)
- The link has `redirect_to=https%3A%2F%2Fivxholding.com%2Freset-password`

But the owner says it drove them to ivxholding.com (the homepage), not to reset-password. Let me think about why.

Possible reasons:
1. The token was already used (one-time use) — I generated multiple links, and the owner may have clicked an old one
2. Supabase redirected to `site_url` instead of `redirect_to` because the redirect_to wasn't actually allowed at the time the link was generated
3. The `ivxholding.com/reset-password` route on the web/Expo side doesn't exist as a deep link, so when Chrome opens it, it goes to ivxholding.com which is the landing page, and there's no /reset-password route there

Wait — `ivxholding.com` is the LANDING PAGE (web), not the Expo app. The Expo app is a mobile app. There is no web route at `ivxholding.com/reset-password`. So when Chrome opens that URL, it hits the landing page server which doesn't have a /reset-password route, so it probably serves the homepage (SPA fallback or 404→home).

This is the actual bug! The `redirect_to` should be a deep link that opens the EXPO APP, not a web URL. For a mobile app, the redirect needs to be either:
- A custom deep link scheme like `ivxholdings://reset-password` 
- An App Links / Universal URL like `https://ivxholding.com/reset-password` BUT only if the app is configured to handle that URL via associated domains / app links

Let me check app.config.ts for the scheme and the linking config.
